data.name: Fiann
data.gender_notes: Fiann is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Irish word 'fiann', meaning 'warrior'. This name is often associated with the legendary Irish hero Fiann mac Cumhaill. The name Fiann carries the meaning “Warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fiann usually hope their child will grow to embody warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of strength and courage.
data.etymology: Fiann belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fiann total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
